name: Virgin Hotels Nashville
positioning: Lifestyle hotel on Nashville's Music Row, minutes from The Gulch and Downtown, with two-chamber rooms and a 14th-floor rooftop pool
best_for: Music lovers who want a base on Music Row near The Gulch and Downtown
Travelers who like a rooftop pool with skyline views
Guests traveling with dogs, since pets stay free with no size or breed restrictions

facts.text: The hotel is located in Nashville's Music Row, minutes from The Gulch and Downtown Nashville.
The hotel is steps away from Vanderbilt University and the Gulch neighborhood.
Rooms have a dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area with an over-sized mirror and flattering lights.
Rooms have SMEG fridges stocked at street prices.
Suites include a communal space for work and play, with separate chambers.
At Commons Club, Chef Adam Terhune serves reinvented American classics with southern twists.
Funny Library is a coffee shop and communal workspace serving La Colombe coffee.
The hotel runs a line-up of live entertainment and programming.
The Virgin Hotels App lets guests order room service, adjust the temperature, control the lights and TV, and access their room.
The gym and fitness center is on the second floor.
The hotel has spaces for meetings, events and weddings.

highlights.text: The signature two-chamber rooms have separate areas for sleeping and living, divided by a privacy partition.
The Pool Club is a 14th-floor rooftop pool with cabanas, loungers and skyline views.
The Late Great is a speakeasy inspired by the spirit of Nashville's B-Room studios, with rare whiskeys and live sets.
Pets stay free, with no size or breed restrictions.

considerations.text: The hotel is on Music Row, minutes from Downtown Nashville rather than right on it.
WhataHotel notes this contemporary lifestyle hotel may not suit traditional preferences.
